In addition, vulnerabilities may be introduced from the use of artificial intelligence by us and third parties on which we rely.

The Board of Directors is assisted by the Audit Committee, which regularly reviews our cybersecurity program and our use of and risks related to artificial intelligence with management and reports to the Board of Directors.
